image_description: A turtle with a high-domed, dark greyish-brown carapace featuring distinct scute patterns and faint longitudinal ridges. The head is large with reddish-orange markings on the neck and jaw, and small lateral eyes. The limbs are stout with visible scales and claws, resting on a bed of dry leaves and twigs. The plastron (underside) appears to have orange/reddish hues near the limb junctions.
